weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives bright and uncomplicated: a broad blue sky with only a scatter of soft clouds, the sun already keen on the pavement and shopfronts. The air feels clear, edges crisp, and visibility long, but the sun has some bite; UV will run high around midday despite the light cloud, so think sunscreen, sunglasses, and a brim that throws good shade. It’s the sort of day that makes colors pop and shadows tidy.

Through the early to midafternoon, expect that same easy clarity with just a few passing tufts of cloud, pleasant for wandering if you keep to the cooler side of the street. Light layers and breathable fabrics will serve you well, with comfortable walking shoes for unhurried errands. This is a fine time to linger at a café table under an awning, browse a bookshop, or roll a gentle lap through the leafy streets; hang a load of washing and let the sun do its quiet work; or tend balcony herbs between sips of cold water. Keep breaks in the shade and you’ll have a serene, unruffled day.
